proposals.evidence: DEDR 1586 full article (p. 145) gives Kor. (O.) kelbu green rust on copper. Bhat kelbu “green dust on copper” is the same cited Koraga form and sense; its original dialect:Koraga:onti:Onti uncertain dialect tag is retained. The article is used as family classification, not an independent second attestation of Bhat.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 2017 full article (p. 182) gives 2017 (a) Ta. kēḷ (kēṭp-, kēṭṭ-) to hear, listen, learn, ask, inquire, question, investigate, require, request, be informed of, obey; be heard (as a call), reach (as a sound); kēḷā to no purp Bhat kēlɨ “to hear” matches Lindgren Koraga kēlɨ “hear” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
